label: My return: residential status - the rules (s.6)

params.name: stay_days
params.label: s.6(1)(a): in India 182 days or more in the year - resident

params.name: short_days
params.label: s.6(1)(c): 60 days or more in the year ...

params.name: prior_days
params.label: s.6(1)(c): ... and 365 days or more in the 4 years before

params.name: visitor_days
params.label: s.6(1) Explanation 1(b) (Finance Act 2020): an Indian citizen / person of Indian origin visiting India with total income, other than from foreign sources, over 15 lakh - 120 days in place of 60

params.name: rich_income
params.label: s.6(1) Explanation 1(b) and s.6(1A): total income other than income from foreign sources, more than this

params.name: nr_years_rnor
params.label: s.6(6)(a): non-resident in 9 out of the 10 years before - not ordinarily resident

params.name: days_7y_rnor
params.label: s.6(6)(a): in India 729 days or less in the 7 years before - not ordinarily resident

params.name: conditions
params.label: ITR-2 / ITR-3 FilingStatus.ConditionsResStatus: the condition the status rests on (the schema's codes)

params.name: foreign_counts
params.label: s.5: a resident (ordinarily) is taxed on income from anywhere; a not-ordinarily resident and a non-resident only on income received / arising in India - for an RNOR also foreign income from a business controlled in, or a profession set up in, India (s.5(1)(c) proviso)

params.name: rnor_controlled
params.label: s.5(1)(c) proviso: the foreign income an RNOR is taxed on when it comes from a business controlled / profession set up in India

params.name: fa_for
params.label: Schedule FA (foreign assets) - for a resident and ordinarily resident (the ITR-2 instructions: not for RNOR / non-resident)

params.name: fsi_for
params.label: Schedule FSI / TR - not for a non-resident (ITR-2 validation rules 443, 453)

params.name: nr_no
params.label: what a non-resident does not get: the 87A rebate, 80TTB, 80DD / 80DDB / 80U (resident individuals only), the higher basic exemption of a senior / very senior citizen (old regime - for residents), freedom from advance tax at 60+ (s.207(2))

description_nl: 2026-10-07: Residential status for AY 2026-27 (s.6 as amended by the Finance Act 2020): the day counts, the 15 lakh line, the RNOR tests, the schema codes, which foreign income each status is taxed on (s.5) and what a non-resident does not get.
